We have published a set of additional themes for the Eclipse IDE: AI Neon, Dracula, VS Code Dark, GitHub Dark, Nord and One Light.
Each one is a pure resource plug-in, CSS and preference definitions only, installable from an update site. Every theme builds on the platform stylesheets of org.eclipse.ui.themes and recolors them through shared color definitions, so a theme change is a palette change rather than a rewritten stylesheet.
